method: For each marked Q1920, choose an A-containing A5 complement, realize Q on the 32 cosets of that complement, identify its regular characteristic module V, compute N_Sym(32)(V)=AGL5(2), and exhaust the pointwise-A centralizer against the literal collision words.
scope: This excludes completions inside Hol(V)=AGL5(2). Abstractly it excludes finite completions in which V is normal and self-centralizing. A completion may evade by moving V or by having C_L(V) strictly larger than V.
